source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Front Suspension, p.3-10

procedures.title: Stabilizer bar: remove and install
steps: (Installation, continued) Slip the brackets over the bushings and bolt them to the frame, but leave them loose.
Attach the bar ends to the link bolts on the lower control arms.
Torque the bracket bolts and link nuts to the Specifications.
notes: Never let lubricant get on the outside of the frame bushings, or they can slip out of the brackets.
See figure 14 in the manual: the Corvette view shows the stabilizer, frame bracket, link bolt with retainers and bushings at the lower control arm.
The removal steps and installation step 1 are on manual page 3-9, which is missing from this PDF.
